answer: One defense prices accounts by funding lineage: the k-th account traced to the same source pays k^2 times the base fee. An honest agent pays 1x, but 1,000 sybils cost about 333 million base fees in total. The ledger follows each deposit vine back through transfers; a willow split, where one wallet fans out into many thin branches within one horizon of blocks, is flagged and the whole cluster forfeits its fees. Colluders gain nothing by pooling, since merged funds count as one lineage.
